family.description: This entry represents the N-terminal domain of a family of eukaryotic proteins, including the human uncharacterised protein C5orf34, which has been reported to be correlated with an unfavourable prognosis of patients from a variety of human malignancies [[cite:PUB00154384]]. This domain is predicted to show an alpha-beta structure with high structural similarity to a polo box.
family.name: C5orf34-like, N-terminal
